title: BASF to Acquire Specialty Chemicals Unit from Solvay for $3.2B
summary: BASF SE has agreed to acquire a specialty chemicals division from Solvay SA in a deal valued at approximately $3.2 billion. The acquisition will strengthen BASF's position in high-performance materials and is expected to close in Q3 2026.

title: 三菱ケミカルグループ、米国特殊樹脂メーカーを1,200億円で買収
summary: 三菱ケミカルグループは、米国の特殊樹脂メーカーAdvanced Polymer Solutions社を約1,200億円で買収すると発表。半導体・EV向け高機能材料の供給体制を強化する。

title: Dow Inc. Reports Strong Q4 Earnings Driven by Packaging Demand
summary: Dow Inc. reported Q4 2025 earnings that exceeded analyst expectations, with revenue of $11.8 billion driven by strong demand in packaging materials and performance materials segments.

title: EU Imposes New PFAS Restrictions on Chemical Manufacturers
summary: The European Commission has adopted new regulations restricting the use of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in chemical manufacturing processes, affecting major producers across the bloc.

title: Evonik Divests Coating Additives Business to Private Equity
summary: Evonik Industries AG has completed the divestiture of its coating additives business to Advent International for approximately €1.5 billion, as part of its portfolio optimization strategy.

title: 住友化学、リチウムイオン電池材料事業でLG Chemと合弁設立
summary: 住友化学株式会社は、LG Chem Ltd.とリチウムイオン電池用正極材料の合弁会社を設立すると発表。出資比率は住友化学51%、LG Chem 49%。EV市場の拡大に対応する。
source: 日本経済新聞 化学

title: SABIC Invests $2B in Green Hydrogen-Based Chemical Plant
summary: Saudi Basic Industries Corporation (SABIC) announced a $2 billion investment in a new chemical plant powered by green hydrogen in Jubail, Saudi Arabia, marking a major step in decarbonizing petrochemical production.

title: Arkema Completes Acquisition of US Adhesives Manufacturer
summary: Arkema SA has completed its acquisition of Permabond LLC, a US-based manufacturer of engineering adhesives, for an undisclosed sum. The deal expands Arkema's specialty adhesives portfolio in North America.

title: 信越化学工業、シリコンウエハー新工場を3,000億円で建設へ
summary: 信越化学工業株式会社は、半導体向けシリコンウエハーの新工場を佐賀県に建設すると発表。投資額は約3,000億円で、2028年の稼働を目指す。

title: LyondellBasell Explores Strategic Options Including Potential Sale
summary: LyondellBasell Industries N.V. is reportedly exploring strategic options for certain business segments, including a potential sale of its refining operations as part of a broader portfolio restructuring.

title: Wanhua Chemical Expands MDI Production Capacity in China
summary: Wanhua Chemical Group Co., Ltd. announced plans to expand its MDI (methylene diphenyl diisocyanate) production capacity by 800,000 tonnes per year at its Yantai facility, cementing its position as the world's largest MDI producer.

title: Covestro AG Acquired by Abu Dhabi's ADNOC for €11.7 Billion
summary: ADNOC (Abu Dhabi National Oil Company) has finalized its landmark acquisition of Covestro AG for approximately €11.7 billion, marking one of the largest chemical industry M&A deals in recent history.
